# update

Updates the ox-vibesec plugin and the OX VibeSec hook code that it runs, then removes the duplicate hooks that the OX installer adds and verifies the result. Use when the user asks to update OX, update VibeSec, upgrade the ox plugin, re-run the OX installer, or says that OX is out of date.

Ships in the [`ox-vibesec`](../../README.md) plugin of [Uraxii/dotai](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai). The agent reads [SKILL.md](SKILL.md); this file is for people.

## Requirements

Needs Claude Code, the ox-vibesec plugin, and network access to run the OX installer.

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install ox-vibesec@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
